blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Davao City Mayor Sebastian Duterte has claimed that he only knew of Gencorp Industries Incorporated because it was mentioned before the impeachment trial against his sister, Vice President Sara Duterte — even if the company had entered into contracts with the local government. During the resumption of the impeachment trial on Tuesday, Mayor Duterte — whom the prosecution presented as a hostile witness — was asked by prosecution counsel Theodore Te whether he knew about the company, since he mentioned it in a previous social media post.
